purpose: Scores a password as the person types: a checklist of rules, a five-segment meter and a level label from Too Weak to Very Strong. Place it under a new-password field.

notFor.case: Only a compact bar fits, with no checklist or label.
A password field for signing in, where no rules apply.

Strength=0.meaning: No rule met; computed from the password the app passes (or pinned by the app).
Strength=0.visual: Meter empty (PasswordStrengthMeter Strength=0); level label "Too Weak" hidden visually, kept for screen readers.

Strength=1.visual: One segment filled; level "Too Weak" in Status/critical/content.

Strength=5.visual: All five segments; level "Very Strong" in Status/success/content.

a11y.role: meter (aria-valuenow 0–5); the level is announced politely (aria-live)
a11y.keyboard: Not focusable; no keyboard interaction of its own.
notes: Each rule says met or not met, so colour is never the only signal.
The card: Surface/layer-1 fill, Border/subtle edge.

openQuestions: Should the level be announced on every keystroke, or only when it changes level?
